[size=3][b]-Description-[/b][/size][/u]

[b]Choso[/b] is a customized new [b]NPC[/b] that you can add into your game in Stardew Valley. He functions as any other NPC in the game.
He does [b]NOT[/b] replace any other NPC.

- He is [b]dateable[/b], and you can [b]marry[/b] him.
- He has his own spouse room & patio.
- He shows up to all the festivals. Even the new [b]Desert Festival[/b][b] [/b]as well as the [b]Night market[/b].
- His birthday is set on [b]Fall 7[/b]. ([i]I can't find his canon birthday so hopefully this is close enough lol[/i])
- He does have some [b]unique dialogue[/b] for specific gifts you give him.[i] (Might add more in the future)[/i] 
- He is [b]NOT[/b] compatible with extension packs such as [i]Stardew Valley Expanded. [b](Download compatible version in files)[/b][/i]

[i](Heart events have been added)[/i]

[b](KNOWN BUGS)
[/b]- If you're playing on an old save file, Choso wont move from his starting point for the whole day. [b]However[/b] [b]he will continue with his schedule the next day![/b]
- Some of the [b]heart events[/b] wont work properly if you have mods that changes the map of specific locations. (Wizards Tower, Archaeology Center etc.)


[size=4][b][u][img]https://imgur.com/Ukmrp5P.png[/img]
﻿
[/u][/b][/size]1.[b] Install Smapi:[/b] https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400
2. [b]Install Content Patcher: [/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915
3. [b]Download this mod.
[/b]4. [b]Unzip mod into Stardew Valley Mods folder in your files.
[/b](If you're new at installing mods I recommend watching a youtube tutorial on it) 


[size=4][b]If there are issues with the installment try this:

[/b][/size]- Install [b]WinRAR[/b]
- Install Choso mod again
- use the "[b]Extract to 'Choso JJK Custom NPC[/b]'" option

The zipped file will then give you a [b]folder[/b] that you can drag into the Stardew mods folder. And it should work after that!

[b]6:10AM Starts off in the Wizards tower (every day)[/b]
---
[b]Mon:[/b]
6:30AM: Goes to the waterfall south of the forest.
11:00PM: Heads off to north west part of the forest. (Above Wizards Tower)
3:00PM: Goes to the small lake bridge in the forest. (Next to Wizards Tower)
9:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---
[b]Tue:[/b]
6:30AM: Goes to the forest River. (Stands at the end of the path next to Leahs House)
10:00AM: Goes to Graveyard in town.
1:00PM: Goes to Archaeology House.
6:00PM: Goes to Community Center.
11:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---

11:00PM: Heads off to north west part of the forest. (Above Wizards Tower)

9:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---

6:30AM: Goes to the waterfall south of the forest.
8:40AM: Arrives at waterfall.
12:00PM: Goes to Archaeology House.
6:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---
[b]Fri:[/b]
10:00AM: Goes to the big tree in the forest. (Next to the traveling merchant)
8:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---
[b]sat:[/b]
6:30AM: Goes to the waterfall south of the forest.
11:00PM: Heads off to north west part of the forest. (Above Wizards Tower)
3:00PM: Goes to the small lake bridge in the forest. (Next to Wizards Tower)
9:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
---
[b]Sun:[/b]
6:30AM: Goes to the waterfall south of the forest.
11:00PM: Heads off to north west part of the forest. (Above Wizards Tower)
3:00PM: Goes to the small lake bridge in the forest. (Next to Wizards Tower)
11:00PM: Heads back to Wizards Tower.
